fluff.overview: Lyran infantry draw confidence from knowing their equipment is first-rate, even when assigned to garrison duty on worlds far from the front lines. Mechanized tracked platoons deploy from armored personnel carriers that provide protection during movement and allow the formation to keep pace with heavier combat vehicles in offensive operations. Armed with assault rifles and Gungnir heavy support gauss rifles, these platoons carry crew-served magnetic-acceleration weapons that deliver exceptional penetrating power against armored targets at long range.
